🚧 Work in Progress (WIP)

⚔️ Strategy Council

AI-powered strategic advisory council — offline, private, multi-agent simulation


--- **Strategy Council** runs a structured war-game simulation entirely on your machine. You describe a scenario; a council of autonomous AI agents — each embodying a distinct strategic doctrine from history's greatest thinkers — debates it, challenges each other's positions, and produces synthesized recommendations. **Zero data leaves your machine. Ever.** ## Key Features - **5 AI Strategist Advisors** — Sun Tzu, Chanakya, Marcus Aurelius, Machiavelli, and Clausewitz, each reasoning from their embedded source texts - **Multi-Agent Debate Simulation** — Structured multi-round deliberation powered by CAMEL-AI/OASIS multi-agent patterns - **100% Offline — Zero Cloud Dependency** — All LLM inference runs locally via Ollama on an internal Docker network - **Knowledge Graph Visualization** — Interactive D3.js force-directed graph with Neo4j backend and visual diff after variable injection - **Red Team Agent** — Devil's advocate that stress-tests the emerging consensus in final rounds - **Voice Interface** — Offline Whisper STT + Coqui TTS with distinct voices per strategist - **Immutable Audit Trail** — SHA-256 hash-chained session logs with PDF/JSON/Markdown export - **8 Scenario Templates** — Pre-built templates for common strategic challenges - **Tauri Native Desktop App** — Lightweight native desktop shell with system tray integration ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites - [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/) (or Docker Engine + Docker Compose) - **8 GB RAM** minimum (16 GB+ recommended) ### 1. Clone & Install ```bash git clone https://github.com/gtm-k/strategy-council.git cd strategy-council ``` ### 2. Configure Environment ```bash # Copy environment configuration (first time only) cp .env.example .env ``` > **Note:** The installer scripts do this automatically. If running Docker Compose manually, copy `.env` first. ### 3. Launch ```bash # macOS / Linux chmod +x installer/install.sh ./installer/install.sh ``` ```powershell # Windows (double-click or run from terminal) installer\install.bat # Or from PowerShell: .\installer\install.ps1 ``` Or manually with Docker Compose: ```bash docker compose up -d --build ``` ### 4. Open Navigate to **http://localhost:3000** — the Council is ready. On first launch, Ollama will pull the LLM model automatically (this takes a few minutes depending on your hardware tier). Once loaded, create a new session, pick a scenario template or write your own, and start the deliberation. ## Hardware Requirements | Tier | RAM | VRAM | Model | Speed | |---|---|---|---|---| | **Laptop (CPU)** | 8–16 GB | None | Qwen3-7B-Q4 | ~8 tok/s | | **Laptop (GPU)** | 16 GB | 8 GB | Qwen3-14B-Q5 | ~18 tok/s | | **Workstation** | 32 GB | 16 GB | Qwen3-32B-Q4 | ~12 tok/s | | **Power Station** | 64 GB+ | 24 GB+ | Llama3.1-70B-Q5 | ~10 tok/s | Hardware detection is automatic. Override in **Settings** or `council_config.yaml` if needed. ## The Council | Strategist | Source Doctrine | Focus | |---|---|---| | **Sun Tzu** | *Art of War* | Information asymmetry, deception, force economy | | **Chanakya** | *Arthashastra* | Statecraft, intelligence networks, escalation strategy | | **Marcus Aurelius** | *Meditations* | Resilience, long-game ethics, adversity response | | **Machiavelli** | *The Prince* | Realpolitik, power consolidation, coalition management | | **Clausewitz** | *On War* | Center of gravity, fog of war, strategic friction | ## Architecture ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Tauri Desktop Shell │ │ (Native Window + Menu) │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ │ │ Frontend │ │ Backend │ │ Ollama │ │ │ │ Vue.js 3 │◄──►│ FastAPI │◄──►│ Local │ │ │ │ Tailwind CSS │ │ Python │ │ LLM + │ │ │ │ D3.js Graph │ │ │ │ Embed │ │ │ └──────┬───────┘ └──────┬───────┘ └──────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ WebSocket │ │ │ └────────────────────┤ │ │ ┌──────────┴──────────┐ │ │ │ │ │ │ ┌────────┴────────┐ ┌────────┴────────┐ │ │ │ SQLite DBs │ │ Neo4j CE │ │ │ │ Audit + Memory │ │ Knowledge Graph │ │ │ │ (local fallback)│ │ + Vector Index │ │ │ └─────────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ Docker Compose (council_net bridge) │ │ internal: true — zero cloud dependency │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` | Layer | Technology | |---|---| | Desktop Shell | Tauri 2.0 (Rust) | | Frontend | Vue.js 3 + Vite + Tailwind CSS + D3.js | | Backend | FastAPI (Python 3.11+) | | LLM Inference | Ollama (local, OpenAI-compatible API) | | Knowledge Graph | Neo4j Community Edition + APOC | | Embeddings | nomic-embed-text (768-dim, via Ollama) | | Audit Trail | SQLite + SHA-256 hash chain | | Voice | Whisper (STT) + Coqui TTS | | Orchestration | Docker Compose (internal bridge network) | ### Data Sovereignty All services communicate over a Docker bridge network configured with `internal: true`. This means: - **No DNS resolution** outside the container network - **No HTTP/HTTPS** egress to the internet - **All LLM inference** happens locally via Ollama - **Verified with `tcpdump`** before each release — zero external packets ## Scenario Templates | Template | Description | |---|---| | **Competitive Entry** | A funded competitor enters your core market — defend your position | | **Market Expansion** | Evaluate entry into a new geography, vertical, or customer segment | | **Crisis Response** | Manage an acute crisis threatening reputation, operations, or survival | | **M&A Defense** | Respond to an unsolicited acquisition or hostile takeover bid | | **Product Launch** | Plan the strategic launch of a major new product or platform | | **Coalition Building** | Form alliances, partnerships, or industry coalitions for shared objectives | | **Regulatory Challenge** | Navigate new regulations or compliance requirements impacting your business | | **Talent War** | Compete for critical human capital in a tight labor market | ## Configuration The main configuration file is `council_config.yaml`: ```yaml council: default_advisors: [sun_tzu, chanakya, marcus_aurelius, machiavelli, clausewitz] default_rounds: 8 red_team: enabled hardware: tier: workstation # auto-detected model: qwen3-32b-q4 # auto-selected voice: enabled: true activation: push_to_talk ``` See `.env.example` for all environment variables. Copy to `.env` and adjust for your setup. ## Development ### Backend ```bash cd backend python -m venv venv source venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5001 --reload ``` ### Frontend ```bash cd frontend npm install npm run dev ``` ### Docker (Full Stack) ```bash docker compose up -d --build ``` ### Running Tests ```bash cd backend python -m pytest tests/ -v ``` ### Adding a New Doctrine Pack No code changes required — the system auto-discovers new personas: 1. Create a YAML persona file in `backend/council/personas/` 2. Create a doctrine pack directory in `backend/council/doctrine_packs/` 3. Add the source text as `source.txt` ## API Reference | Method | Endpoint | Description | |---|---|---| | `POST` | `/api/sessions` | Create new council session | | `GET` | `/api/sessions` | List all sessions | | `GET` | `/api/sessions/{id}` | Get session details | | `POST` | `/api/sessions/{id}/start` | Start deliberation | | `POST` | `/api/sessions/{id}/inject` | Variable injection | | `GET` | `/api/sessions/{id}/report` | Get council report | | `GET` | `/api/sessions/{id}/audit` | Get audit trail | | `POST` | `/api/sessions/{id}/export` | Export (PDF/JSON/MD) | | `GET` | `/api/personas` | List strategists | | `GET` | `/api/templates` | List scenario templates | | `GET` | `/api/config` | Get configuration | | `PUT` | `/api/config` | Update configuration | | `POST` | `/api/voice/stt` | Speech to text | | `POST` | `/api/voice/tts` | Text to speech | | `WS` | `/ws/sessions/{id}` | Real-time simulation stream | ## Contributing Contributions welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development guidelines, code style, and pull request expectations. ## Security Strategy Council is designed as an **offline-first** application with zero external network dependencies. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for our full security policy, data sovereignty guarantees, and vulnerability reporting process. To report a vulnerability, email **security@strategycouncil.dev** or use GitHub's private security advisory feature. ## License This project is licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0](LICENSE). ## Acknowledgments - **[MiroFish-Offline](https://github.com/nikmcfly/MiroFish-Offline)** by [nikmcfly](https://github.com/nikmcfly) — Production utilities layer (LLM client, Neo4j storage, embeddings, NER, hybrid search, retry logic, file parser, D3.js graph visualization). Licensed under AGPL-3.0. - **[MiroFish](https://github.com/nikmcfly/MiroFish)** — Original social simulation engine - **[CAMEL-AI](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel)** — Multi-agent simulation patterns - **[Ollama](https://ollama.ai)** — Local LLM inference - **[Neo4j Community Edition](https://neo4j.com)** — Knowledge graph storage - **[Tauri](https://tauri.app)** — Native desktop application framework - Doctrine texts sourced from public domain translations
